audit.whatIsWrong: The chart credited Level 1 to Vladimir while whys[0] on the same page says Volibear's passive and Frenzied Maul beat your level-1 poke. Levels 4-5, Level 6 and First item all sat on 'Skill' while the prose describes 4-5 and 6 as his strongest window and first item as your flip.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Volibear, Skill, Skill, Volibear, Volibear, Vladimir, Vladimir — which is exactly the story the whys and mid/late text already tell.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 4 to Volibear; row 5 to Vladimir; ratings moved with them, proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spike timings are right: his levels 4-5 all-in and level 6 dive, your first-item flip and full-AP late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Smash was called a root in six places. Riot's text says it Stuns, and it is an auto-attack reset — the stun lands on his next attack, not on the cast. No line carried a real cooldown, and Frenzied Maul's healing and on-hit scaling were never tied to anti-heal timing.
audit.why: Kit file: Q Thundering Smash 300 range / 12-10s, hardCC + autoReset; W Frenzied Maul 5s, heals on the re-cast and applies on-hit; E Sky Splitter 1200 range / 16s, slow plus shield if he stands in it; R Stormbringer 160/135/110s, disables nearby towers. Vladimir Q and E reach 600, Pool is 2s untargetable.
audit.corrected: Stun wording throughout, the auto-reset tell written as the pool cue, and the real 12s / 5s / 160s cooldowns put into the do's and don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was listed in itemization but no line said when it must be bought, and armour alone was implied to read the trade.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul heals on every re-cast at a 5s cooldown and applies on-hit effects that scale with his passive attack speed.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now names the 5s re-cast heal and Grievous Wounds.
